description: Run Magist’s deterministic compliance engine over a product description (features, target markets, audience age bands, optional business model) and return the regulations and Controls that may be triggered, a complexity tier with a numeric score, a blocker count, and a per-audience cohort breakdown. The call also creates or refreshes an idempotent public report URL for the receipt, retained for up to 90 days. Deterministic and reproducible: the same inputs always produce the same output, with no LLM in the path. Returns which obligations may apply for research purposes; it is not a determination that they do apply, and does not replace counsel. Consult a licensed attorney before relying on the result.

audiences.description: Audience age bands. Exactly these three ids exist.

businessModel.description: Optional business-model context (role, participants, transactionInvolvement, dataHandling). Validated server-side via the same allowlist as /api/compute-requirements.

features.description: Product feature ids from the closed catalog, e.g. ["account-creation","text-chat","iap","ai-content-gen"]. Call list_feature_catalog for the full set of valid ids; an id outside the catalog is rejected with an actionable error.

markets.description: Target market codes, e.g. ["eu","us","california","uk"]. Call list_feature_catalog for the full set of valid ids; an id outside the catalog is rejected with an actionable error.

name: compute_requirements
title: Compute regulatory requirements
